TEMP_FILE = "./temp-process-tensor.hdf5"

correlations = oqupy.PowerLawSD(
    alpha=0.3,
    zeta=1.0,
    cutoff=5.0,
    cutoff_type="exponential",
    temperature=0.2,
    name="ohmic")bath = oqupy.Bath(
    0.5*oqupy.operators.sigma("x"),
